annotations.title: Ask Miss QE (QE Virtual AI Machine)

description: Ask Miss QE, the economic engineer of the OwlChart QE Virtual AI Machine, about the money pipes of one country: central bank, government debt, bond yield, exchange rate, inflation, unemployment and more, each read from the national source. She answers in the language of the question: which pipes drain or flow, what would repair each one and who holds the tap. Every number is checked against the machine. Needs the Miss QE pass; without it the answer is the price and where to buy. Not advice.

country.description: Country code of the machine: us, eu, es, de, fr, it, gb, jp, cn, au, nz, kr and the rest; GET https://owlchart.com/api/liquidity/countries lists them
